So as well as checking the overall condition of the camera, be sure to ask the seller what the current shutter count is, as this will give you an indication as to how much life is left in the camera.
4.5fps burst shooting and 2-inch LCD screen.

The wide shutter speed of 30-1/16,000sec was also a welcome addition.

So if you want to shoot fast action or wildlife, it’s best to prioritise fast burst speeds .
